evidence: PARTIAL: Required image contents and local launch are supported, but the required full configured launch/grading measurement is absent. Frozen workbook row 22 (Quality Checks!D23 and Internal Quality Checks!D23) requires the pinned browser, Playwright, judge CLI, RewardKit and app runtime. Frozen task/tests/Dockerfile:1-4 copies Node 22 into Python 3.12; :16-22 pins Claude Code 2.1.281, Playwright MCP 0.0.79, Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1; :31 pins harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7; :33-38 installs Chromium through that Playwright release and links /usr/local/bin/chromium. The Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template. task/solution/app/package.json:13-15 and the require/import scan expose no missing non-built-in runtime package; the agent image installs the same Express/SQLite versions (environment/Dockerfile:9-11). Actual verifier-build.log:73-77 completed image sha256:6d0879cbd08d7ad676032173a2634e5d3e505c4a660c47d1a7060ee070a3c722; agent-build.log:63-67 completed sha256:6f870f89caf1f289e70732cbc1d5a430722288d7902f0dc56f58728da69b0e84. input-binding.json:92-128 reports the same image IDs and matching actual /tests file bytes; I verified every indexed artifact and matching frozen source hash (497 comparisons, zero mismatches). mcp-run.log:1-8 records Node v22.23.2, Chrome for Testing 152.0.7977.8, real MCP tools, UI creation, independent-context readback, response hold/release and overlapping requests. The stale Windows localVariation label in mcp/results.json:51 is contradicted by its actual Linux command at :40-49 and run-local.sh:9-11; it does not establish a Windows run. install-lifecycle.py:19-20 uses env -i, NODE_PATH, setpriv uid/gid 65534 and cwd /tests; results.json:16-64 records successful install, app operations, ordinary Python MCP process replacement and durable readback; app.log confirms port 3000 startup. Installed RewardKit discovery/CLI construction resolved all five dimensions without context/criteria placeholders (configured-inspection/results.json); functional command size was 101943 bytes with a largest argument of 81724 bytes, and each argument-size launch exited 0. Claude Code --version and playwright-mcp --version exited 0. However inspect-configured.py:22-23 explicitly substitutes /usr/bin/true for the judge executable for those argument launches. CLI version, parser/schema resolution, browser scenarios and installer tests do not execute the configured OpenRouter/GLM grade or final scored output. The evidence index labels these local observations only; input-binding.json:138 has provider_runs=false; runtime-evidence.json is absent. Per qc/README.md and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md, this required measurement cannot be waived. No confirmed missing-package or app-launch defect was found; this row remains a grading-evidence gap rather than a claimed Oracle/model/portal failure.
counterexample: Adversarial sufficiency check: the measured dead_approval variant in local/gate-witness/results.json still satisfies basic pending-record observations, although approvals are disabled. It would also pass image-build and CLI-parser checks, illustrating why those observations cannot establish full grading or discrimination. Conforming alternative: a Node 22 app using only the documented Express/SQLite packages, absolute app-relative assets, PORT and DB_PATH has the required dependencies; the golden supplies a successful unprivileged launch control. A later provider authentication/response-parsing failure could still leave that conforming app with the zero initialized at tests/test.sh:60 and retained when run_suite fails at :213-225. That evaluator path is unmeasured, not an observed app failure.
suggested_fix: After the owner has provider-run authorization and credentials, execute the unchanged full configured verifier on this frozen candidate and record actual image identity, command, duration, suite/judge logs and final score artifacts in hash-bound runtime evidence; preserve the currently successful local launch evidence and do not substitute parser or stub results for a grade.
